title: Transforming Cities: Manila’s flood fighters
summary: This C40 case study describes “Transforming Cities: Manila’s flood fighters,” an urban initiative documented for Manila. It is included because it addresses river flood, tropical storm hazards, and it is located in the Global South. C40 describes the action this way: In Manila, Cherry and her community decided to take on the typhoons that were devastating her neighbourhood.

intervention.objectives: In Manila, Cherry and her community decided to take on the typhoons that were devastating her neighbourhood.
intervention.measures:
After almost having to flee her home for a second time due to flooding, Cherry and her community decided to take on the typhoons that were devastating her neighbourhood.
